full_state_accuracy: percentage of rows whose four-component Euclidean state error is <= 0.1; mixed normalized units
position_accuracy: percentage of rows whose 2D Euclidean position error is <= 0.05 normalized workspace units
velocity_accuracy: percentage of rows whose 2D Euclidean velocity error is <= 0.05 normalized velocity units
control_increment_accuracy_at_0_05: diagnostic percentage whose recovered two-component one-step normalized velocity-increment error is <= 0.05; the increment is recovered from delta_position and parent_velocity using the exact constant-acceleration equation

configured_thresholds_physical.full_state: not a single physical unit; combines normalized position and velocity

mse_definition: mean squared component error over all rows and all four state components
deterministic_definition: single zero-noise output used as the deployable prediction metric
bestof_definition: oracle diagnostic: generate candidate_count outputs and use the true label afterward to select the closest; never a deployable selector
